    int n;
    int h[MAXN], vh[MAXN], source, sink;
    int mk[MAXN];
    void init(int n)
    {
        this->n = n;
        memset(cap, 0, sizeof(cap));
        memset(g, 0, sizeof(g));
        memset(mk, 0, sizeof(mk));
    }
    void addCap(int i, int j, int val)
    {
        cap[i][j] += val;
        g[i][j] = 1;
    }

    {
        if (idx == sink)
            return maxCap;
        int l = maxCap, d, minH = n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (cap[idx][i] - flow[idx][i] > 0)
            {
                if (h[idx] == h[i] + 1)
                {
                    d = sap(i, min(l, cap[idx][i] - flow[idx][i]));
                    flow[idx][i] += d;
                    flow[i][idx] -= d;
                    l -= d;
                    if (h[source] == n || l == 0) return maxCap - l;
                }
                minH = min(minH, h[i] + 1);
            }
        }
        if (l == maxCap)
        {
            vh[h[idx]]--;
            vh[minH]++;
            if (vh[h[idx]] == 0)
                h[source] = n;
            h[idx] = minH;
        }
        return maxCap - l;
    }
    int solve(int source, int sink)
    {
        if (source == sink) return inf;
        this->sink = sink;
        this->source = source;
        memset(flow, 0, sizeof(flow));
        memset(h, 0, sizeof(h));
        memset(vh, 0, sizeof(vh));
        int ans = 0;
        while (h[source] != n)
            ans += sap(source, inf);
        return ans;
    }
}sap;

                next.x = x; next.y = y; next.step = now.step + 1;

                Q.push(next);
            }
        }
    }

        scanf("%s", mat2[i] + 1);
    int source = 0, sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
    sap.init(sink + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
    {

        {

        }
    }
    int res = sap.solve(source, sink);
    cout << res << endl;
}
